title: What is WebMCP? Chrome's browser-native API for AI agents

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if your browser could run AI agents natively, like apps—without plugins or servers?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: WebMCP lets AI agents run directly in Chrome, using WebAssembly and secure sandboxing for performance and safety.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But who controls these agents? Could they collect data, manipulate users, or become invasive without consent?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are using strict permission models and transparency tools to ensure user control and data minimization.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI agents help with tasks ethically, respecting privacy and user intent.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: WebMCP may redefine how we interact with AI—responsibly, efficiently, and deeply integrated into our daily lives.

video_cue: A browser window with AI agents performing tasks like scheduling meetings and coding, all within a secure, transparent interface.
